channel.description: Last 10 notes on Sagiv's Knowledge Base

item.title: Set Difference
item.description: Sign \setminus Definition A \setminus B = A-B = \{x|x \in A,\text{and} \ x \not \in B\} Latex \setminus Example \{1,2,3,4\} \setminus \{3,4\}=\{1,2\}.

item.title: Null Space
item.description: Definition The null space is a Subspace consisting of all input Vectors \vec x that are mapped to the Zero Vector when multiplied by a Matrix \mathbf{A}.

item.title: Column Space
item.description: Definition A column space of a Matrix is a Span of its Column Vectors. The column space is also called the Rank of a matrix.

item.title: Dimension
item.description: Definition The dimension is the size of the space, defined by the number of Vectors contained in any Basis for that space.

item.title: Identity Matrix
item.description: Definition The identity matrix of size n*n, \mathbf{I}_n is a square Matrix with ones on the main diagonal and zeros elsewhere.

item.title: Basis and Dimension Problems
item.description: Span Question 1 What is the span of Matrix \mathbf{A} Given \mathbf{A} = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 0 & 2 \\ 2 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 3 & 1 \end{pmatrix} Solution A span of a matrix is the collection of the Column Vectors with a Linear Combination.

item.title: 08 Diagonalization
item.description: Overview Diagonalization is the process of using a Linear Transformation on a Matrix \mathbf{A} into a Diagonal Matrix by the form \Lambda, by relating it to a Basis composed of its Eigenvectors.

item.title: Diagonal Matrix
item.description: Definition A diagonal matrix is a type of Matrix where the non diagonal components are 0 and the diagonal component are the Eigenvalues.

item.title: Eigenbasis
item.description: Definition The eigenbasis is a Set of Basis Vectors that are also Eigenvectors of a Matrix \mathbf{A}.

item.title: Eigenvector Matrix
item.description: Definition The eigenvector matrix \mathbf{X} of a matrix \mathbf{A} is a Matrix formed by placing the Eigenvectors of \mathbf{A} on its columns.
